name: Goa Beach Escape
description: Golden beaches, Portuguese-era churches and lively beach shacks along India's west coast.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa and Beach Visit
itinerary.description: Arrive in Goa and check in to your hotel. Relax for some time and visit Baga Beach in the evening. Enjoy the beautiful sunset and explore nearby beach shacks.

itinerary.title: North Goa Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Fort Aguada, Calangute Beach, Candolim Beach and Anjuna Beach. Enjoy beach activities, shopping and local Goan food.

itinerary.title: South Goa and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and explore nearby attractions. Visit a local market before checking out and departing from Goa.

excluded: Entry tickets not mentioned in the package

name: Manali Hills Adventure
description: Gateway to the Himalayas — snow-capped peaks, Solang Valley and Rohtang Pass.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali
itinerary.description: Arrive in Manali and check in to your hotel. Relax and explore Mall Road in the evening. Enjoy the beautiful mountain atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Local Manali Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Hadimba Devi Temple, Manu Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs and the beautiful Van Vihar. Explore local markets in the evening.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Adventure
itinerary.description: Visit Solang Valley and enjoy panoramic Himalayan views. You can try activities such as paragliding, ropeway rides and other adventure sports at additional cost.

itinerary.title: Mountain Excursion
itinerary.description: Enjoy a scenic mountain excursion towards the snow points or Rohtang Pass, subject to weather, permits and road conditions.

itinerary.title: Departure from Manali
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast, complete hotel check-out and depart from Manali with wonderful memories.

excluded: Rohtang Pass permits and special vehicle charges

name: Kerala Backwaters
description: Cruise the palm-fringed backwaters of Vembanad Lake on a traditional houseboat.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi
itinerary.description: Arrive in Kochi and check in to your hotel. Visit Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets and nearby local markets.

itinerary.title: Journey to Munnar
itinerary.description: Travel towards Munnar through beautiful green landscapes and waterfalls. Visit tea gardens and enjoy the pleasant hill station atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Backwater Experience
itinerary.description: Travel to Alleppey and enjoy a scenic backwater cruise. Experience traditional Kerala houseboats and beautiful views of coconut trees and villages.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and some free time. Check out from the hotel and depart with memorable experiences of Kerala.

excluded: Entry tickets not mentioned in the package

name: Royal Rajasthan Trail
description: Explore the Pink City — Hawa Mahal, Amber Fort and royal Rajputana heritage.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jaipur and check in to your hotel. Explore local markets and enjoy traditional Rajasthani food.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts and Palaces
itinerary.description: Visit Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal and City Palace. Discover the royal history and architecture of Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur
itinerary.description: Travel to Jodhpur and check in to your hotel. Explore the famous Clock Tower Market and nearby streets.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur Heritage Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada and Umaid Bhawan Palace. Enjoy the beautiful blue streets of the city.

itinerary.title: Explore Udaipur
itinerary.description: Travel towards Udaipur and explore Lake Pichola, City Palace and the beautiful lakeside surroundings.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and some free time for shopping. Complete check-out and depart from Rajasthan.

name: Rishikesh Spiritual Journey
description: Yoga capital of the world, set on the banks of the holy Ganga near Laxman Jhula.

itinerary.title: Arrival and Ganga Aarti
itinerary.description: Arrive in Rishikesh and check in to your accommodation. Visit Ram Jhula and explore the Ganga riverbank. In the evening, attend the famous Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat.

itinerary.title: Temples and Spiritual Exploration
itinerary.description: Start your day with a peaceful yoga session. Visit Neer Garh Waterfall or nearby temples and enjoy the peaceful surroundings before departure.

name: Family Fun Resort Getaway
description: Misty hill station in the Western Ghats, known for waterfalls, forts and valley views.

itinerary.title: Arrival and Resort Stay
itinerary.description: Arrive in Lonavala and check in to your family resort. Enjoy the resort facilities and spend a relaxing evening with your family.

itinerary.title: Lonavala Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Bhushi Dam, Tiger Point and Lonavala Lake. Enjoy scenic valley views and explore local markets.

itinerary.title: Nature Exploration and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and visit nearby attractions such as Karla Caves, depending on available time. Complete check-out and depart.

included: Resort facilities as per property rules

name: Andaman Island Bliss
description: Turquoise waters and coral reefs at Radhanagar Beach, Havelock Island.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair
itinerary.description: Arrive at Port Blair and check in to your hotel. Visit Cellular Jail and enjoy the Light and Sound Show in the evening.

itinerary.title: Journey to Havelock Island
itinerary.description: Travel by ferry to Havelock Island. Check in to your accommodation and visit the beautiful Radhanagar Beach.

itinerary.title: Island and Water Activities
itinerary.description: Explore the beaches of Havelock Island. Enjoy optional activities such as snorkeling and scuba diving at additional cost.

itinerary.title: Return to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Travel back to Port Blair by ferry. Enjoy some free time exploring local markets and nearby attractions.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast, complete hotel check-out and transfer to the airport for your departure.

name: Ladakh Mountain Expedition
description: High-altitude desert landscapes, Buddhist monasteries and the stunning Pangong Lake.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh
itinerary.description: Arrive in Leh and check in to your hotel. Rest and acclimatize to the high altitude. Avoid strenuous activities.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After sufficient rest, visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace and the local market. Enjoy the beautiful views of the surrounding mountains.

itinerary.title: Monastery Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Thiksey Monastery, Shey Palace and nearby cultural attractions. Experience Ladakh's Buddhist heritage.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley Expedition
itinerary.description: Travel through the scenic Khardung La route towards Nubra Valley, subject to road and weather conditions. Explore the beautiful valley.

itinerary.title: Pangong Lake Excursion
itinerary.description: Travel towards the stunning Pangong Lake. Enjoy its changing blue shades and spectacular mountain scenery.

itinerary.title: Return to Leh
itinerary.description: Return to Leh and enjoy some free time. Explore local markets and shop for souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Departure from Leh
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and complete hotel check-out. Transfer to the airport and depart with unforgettable memories.

included: Nubra Valley and Pangong Lake excursion
Transfers by vehicle as per itinerary
excluded: Inner Line Permits and applicable fees unless mentioned
Additional charges due to weather or road closures
